paite: Huan TOUPA’N Mosi kiang ah, “Pharoah tung leh Aigupta gam tung ah gawtna khat ka tun lai ding. Huai khit chiang in hiai a pan ahon paisakta ding hi. Ahon paisak chiang in, hon hawlkhe siang sipsip ding hi.
heading: Mosi In Piang Masa Sih Ding Apuang
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.

paite: Tu in mite zak in thu gen inla, pasal chih in a-inveng kiang ah ngen hen. Numei chih in a-inveng kiang ah dangka suangmantamte leh dangka-eng suangmantamte ngen hen," achi hi.
english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aiguptate mitmuh in mite deihsakna apia hi. Huai lou in Aigupta gam ah, Pharaoh sikhate mitmuh leh mite mitmuh in Mosi athupi mahmah hi.
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

paite: Mosi in, "Hiai bang in TOUPA'N achi, zankim chiang in Aigupta gamsung teng ka tawnsuak ding hi.
english: Moses said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

paite: Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, alaltutphah a tu Pharaoh tapa upapen a pan buhhek a om sikhanu ta masapen leh ganta piang masa tengteng asi ding uhi.
english: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.

paite: Aigupta gam pumpi ah kahna thupitak a-om ding a, huchibang om ngei nai lou, huchibang om ngei nawn lou ding.
english: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

paite: Himahleh Israel suante lak a kuamah siatna ding in, mi hiam ganta hiam siatna ding in ui in alei atangsak kei ding a; TOUPA'N Aiguptate leh Israel akhentuamdan na thei ding hi.
english: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that Yahweh makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ka kiang ah na milian tengteng ahong paisuk ding ua, ahong kun ding ua, 'Nang hon zui mi tengteng toh paikhia un' ahong chi ding uh. Huai khit chiang in ka paikhe ding," chi in hehtak in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apaikhia hi.
english: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka thillamdangte Aigupta gam a apunna ding in Pharaoh in ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in Pharaoh ma ah hiai thillamdang tengteng ahihta ua; TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, gam a kipan Israel suante apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
english: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.
